summary: I spent 20 years in business — consulting, coaching, and managing teams — and ADHD coaching showed me where I actually do my best work: helping people whose brains work differently get understood and supported. I'm now retraining as a Mild/Moderate Special Education teacher in Arizona, with the goal of teaching in the Marana district I call home. This site tracks the work: every exam, every study note, every milestone.
mission: I was diagnosed with ADHD at five years old, and grew up curious about how differently brains learn. That curiosity became a career in coaching adults with ADHD — watching capable people struggle for decades because no one adapted to how they learn best.

I want to reach people earlier. My goal is a special education classroom where differences in learning are something to design for, not fix — where IEPs are written well, families are partners, and neurodivergent students are celebrated.
This portfolio is both the plan and the evidence: the critical path to certification, the tests I'm studying for, the notes I'm building, and the tools I'm making along the way.
